title: Normal Chip H4K16ac BA
author: N.G Martin, Hugo
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Fix cells with formaldehyde
steps.instruction: After isolation, resuspend 1 × 10⁶ cells in 1 % formaldehyde, incubate 14 min at room temperature, then add glycine to a final concentration of 125 mM and incubate 1 min to quench fixation.

steps.title: Wash and harvest cells
steps.instruction: Wash cells three times with PBS containing complete protease inhibitor cocktail (Roche, 11836145001) and 10 mM sodium butyrate (Sigma Aldrich, 303410); then scrape cells from plates to collect.

steps.title: Isolate nuclei with Covaris
steps.instruction: Transfer washed cells to a Covaris E220 tube and sonicate for 4.5 min at peak power 75 W, duty factor 2 % and 200 cycles/burst to isolate nuclei.

steps.title: Quantify chromatin
steps.instruction: Measure chromatin concentration using a Nanodrop spectrophotometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific) and use equal amounts of chromatin for each immunoprecipitation.

steps.title: Perform immunoprecipitation
steps.instruction: Incubate the chromatin with 2 µg of antibody and protein A/G Dynabeads (Thermo Scientific, 88802) under the conditions described in Arrigoni 2018, omitting barcode ligation and pooling.

steps.title: Quantify immunoprecipitated DNA
steps.instruction: Measure the DNA recovered from the IP using a Qubit 4 Fluorometer (Thermo Scientific).

steps.title: Prepare sequencing libraries
steps.instruction: Construct libraries with the NEBNext Ultra library preparation kit (New England BioLab, E7645S), then assess library quality and quantity on an Agilent BioAnalyzer.

steps.title: Sequence libraries
steps.instruction: Sequence the libraries on an Illumina NovaSeq instrument using 150 bp paired‑end reads.
